entity_raw.definition_raw:
You gain a new spell-like ability from the list of duergar racial traits.

Prerequisite(s): Duergar.

Benefit(s): Choose one spell-like ability that is usable once per day and is granted by a duergar racial trait you don’t have. You can use that spell-like ability once per day, with a caster level equal to your character level.

Special: You can take this feat multiple times. Each time you do, you must select a spell-like ability that’s usable once per day from a different duergar racial trait.
